title: Orsen and the Postcard
author: Elodie Brightwater
blurb: Lena Villalobos, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
